answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need 20 distinct verified counterparties in 20 epochs. Through a prism, honest history shows a wide spectrum; a sybil cluster shows one narrow band. Each link costs 5 POA, so 1,000 fakes need 20,000 links costing 100,000 POA, above the rewards. A dune of fakes collapses on checks: cluster-only counterparties are flagged, their shared signal cut. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
